activities.result: Discover SEO/AEO tactics and platform findings, corroborate or invalidate them, and preserve useful evidence or Learning only when supported.
Design a controlled or defensible quasi-experimental test when an uncertain SEO/AEO tactic is worth testing.
Analyze an SEO/AEO experiment without overstating causality and preserve reusable outcome evidence or Learning only when justified.
Convert sufficiently supported organic-discovery outcomes into reusable context-specific SEO/AEO Learning.
